label: A5B16C_mP22_3_a2e_ab7e_b-001
title: Monoclinic UMo$_{5}$O$_{16}$ Structure
comments:
(Tabachenko, 1995) also found an \href{current_web_home_dir/A6B16C_oP23_16_su_acjlp2u_d-001}{orthorhombic UMo$_{5}$O$_{16}$ structure}, where some of the molybdenum sites are disordered. 
 (Tabachenko, 1995) give the data for this structure in the unique-axis $c$ orientation of space group $P2$ \#3.  We used FINDSYM and AFLOW to transform this to the standard unique-axis $b$ orientation. This makes substantial changes to the primitive vectors. 
 Space group $P2$ allows an arbitrary choice of origin for the y-axis.  Here we set y$_{4}$=0 for the uranium position.
